frequency_question: How often do proposed financial sector tax clarifications or levies face structural friction that prevents formal council approval within a short policy window?
membership_rule: Includes formal proposals brought to the Indian GST Council regarding financial, banking, or NBFC service taxation; excludes routine administrative rate changes.

cases.name: Casino and horse racing retrospective taxation

coverage_note: 5 named major contested financial service tax items; believed roughly 8 in total over the decade.
known_gaps: Some minor state-level exemptions not tracked as national council agenda items.
skeleton: Total major contested financial/service tax proposals considered by the GST Council where industry friction was active.
multiplier: 2 hits out of 5 major contested service/tax friction items = 40% success rate of friction preventing implementation, meaning 60% pass rate.
validity_reason: The voting structure and consensus-seeking nature of the federal council remain stable over medium-term political cycles.
